content.text: When choosing your plan, let us know what matters most to you—cost, benefits, or the doctors, medications and facilities you need covered. Based on your selections, we'll show you a list of recommended plans you can choose from before signing up.
When you think about your monthly payment, which best describes you?

options.label: Pay a lower monthly payment even if it means I have slightly fewer benefits
I don't mind a higher monthly payment to get more benefits

content.text: Tell us more about what you want your plan to do for you.
Which type of benefits do you want in your plan?

options.label: I want one convenient plan which bundles all of the benefits from Medicare Parts A , B, and possibly D
I want a plan that helps fill the gaps by covering costs that Original Medicare does not cover (such as deductibles and coinsurance)
I want a plan which only helps pay the cost of my prescription drugs (Part D only)

content.text: Are there optional benefits that you'd like to add to your plan?

options.label: I need vision and/or dental options

content.text: Tell us when and where you want to access healthcare.

options.label: I don't mind selecting from a network of doctors and facilities that accept Medicare patients
I want the flexibility to go to any facility, doctor, or specialist that accepts Medicare patients.
